data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'dil' meaning heart and 'kush' meaning content or happiness. The name Dilkush signifies being deeply cherished or loved. The name Dilkush carries the meaning “Beloved, Cherished” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Mythology tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilkush usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, cherished and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilkush total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
